overviewParagraphs: Ba Na Hills Golf Club, set at the foot of the Ba Na Mountains in Da Nang, Vietnam, is a multi-award-winning championship layout designed by former World No. 1 Luke Donald. As the signature debut for Donald, the course offers a unique parkland experience that contrasts with the region's typical coastal links.

The layout winds through diverse terrain, from valley floors to dramatic hillside peaks, featuring significant elevation changes and natural water hazards. One of its standout features is the state-of-the-art LED lighting system, making it the premier destination for night golf in Vietnam.

Managed by IMG, the club maintains world-class standards, utilizing SeaIsle Paspalum grass to ensure a premium playing surface year-round. Whether playing under the tropical sun or the glow of stadium lights, Ba Na Hills provides an unforgettable technical test.

curatorBriefHtml: Ba Na Hills Golf Club — Luke Donald’s debut architectural design managed by IMG — is the mountain centerpiece of every Da Nang golf circuit. Set in the cool valleys at the foothills of the Ba Na mountain range roughly 30 minutes west of Da Nang, the Par 72 layout stretches to 7,858 yards from the Black tips (6,609 yards Blue) across rolling forested terrain that plays 5–8°C cooler than the humid coastline.

Having worked previously at Ba Na Hills Golf Club and played it countless times, my strongest recommendation for touring groups is simple: book a 2:30 PM twilight tee time. Playing the dramatic, wind-sheltered front nine in afternoon sun before watching the high-powered LED floodlights ignite across the water-laced back nine delivers the single most memorable atmosphere in Southeast Asian golf — without losing the visual drama of Luke Donald’s dramatic elevation drops.

Because Ba Na Hills sits inland away from ocean breezes, it pairs as the perfect stylistic foil to coastal links rounds at Hoiana Shores and BRG Da Nang. Read our full hole-by-hole guide in Ba Na Hills Golf Club Review: Night Golf & Fees or compare it directly in Hoiana Shores vs. Ba Na Hills.

scorecard.verdict: Ba Na Hills is the quintessential mountain championship layout in Southeast Asia. Luke Donald's tactical routing rewards disciplined club selection from dramatic elevated tees, while the comprehensive floodlighting creates an unmatched evening tournament atmosphere. An essential anchor round for any Da Nang golf tour.

faqs.q: What is the best tee time for Ba Na Hills Golf Club — daytime or night golf?
faqs.a: Book a 2:15–2:45 PM tee time whenever possible. You experience the mountain foothills and dramatic elevation changes on the front nine in natural light, then finish the back nine under full 18-hole LED floodlights as dusk settles across the valley.

faqs.q: How does Ba Na Hills play compared to coastal Da Nang courses?
faqs.a: Ba Na Hills sits inland at the foothills of the Truong Son mountains, meaning virtually zero coastal wind, temperatures 5–8°C cooler than Da Nang beach, and generous target corridors framed by forested hills rather than sand dunes.

faqs.q: How long is the transfer from Da Nang or Hoi An to Ba Na Hills?
faqs.a: Allow 30–35 minutes by private touring vehicle from central Da Nang / My Khe Beach, or 45–55 minutes from Hoi An and An Bang Beach villas. AGS handles evening return transfers smoothly after night-golf rounds.

faqs.q: Which tees should visiting club golfers play at Ba Na Hills?
faqs.a: While the Black Tees stretch to an epic 7,858 yards, visiting golfers enjoy the layout far more from the Blue Tees (6,609 yards) or White Tees (6,022 yards), where Luke Donald’s risk-reward par 4s and elevated par 3s play as intended.
